photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
To print passport photos with your PC, you must first download software that allows you to obtain 35mm x 45mm photos (or 50mm x 70mm for Canadian passport). Then, you will have to connect a printer compatible with photo paper to your PC because only professionally printed passport photos are accepted.

If you don't want to download any software or skip the trouble of searching for an easy tool online, you can opt for the Smartphone iD service, where you only need to choose the needed document type and everything else is done for you. You can receive a professional 10x15cm print to your doorstep or use the 10x15cm digital file we send to email and use it in a printing facility nearby.

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon: <aside class="kal-accordion-item-active-aside">Get your passport photo taken at several Canadian stores like Walmart, London Drugs,passport photographers, Staples, and Shopper’s Drug Mart. Alternatively, or can obtain your passport photo online through the 'Smartphone iD app,' which offers an affordable and convenient option to take the photo from home.</aside>

To take a good passport photo at home you must do the following:

  • Stand against the source of light to get even lighting on your face, and neck. It's best to do it in daylight facing window.
  • Make sure that your background is in light color and no shadow appears behind you.
  • Look into the camera objective and not the phone screen. Eyes should be open.
  • In case of selfie, make sure that your hand is stretched fully and stays on the level of shoulders.

If you are not sure whether all guidelines have been respected, you can use the Smartphone iD tool. The photo will be automatically sized and approved by trained experts to ensure 100% compliance with official standards.

It depends on the document type. Official documents that are used for biometrical machine reading (electronic passports, visas, identity cards) don't allow fringe because it makes it harder to read the biometrical data from the scan. Then fringe must be sided to either side and pinned down with unnoticeable bobby pins.
However, more casual identity documents like a student card, or transportation card can have a passport photo with a fringe.
If you are not sure about the requirements, you can use Smartphone iD service that will get you a conform and checked photo for the document of your choice.

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
Yes, you can wear makeup in your passport photo. But note that make-up should be light.

  • Don't put too much eyeshadow on your eyelids.
  • Often glossy lipstick might create a reflection, therefore, better opt for a matte lipstick, if you want to accent your lips.
  • It's useful also to check that your skin is not oily before taking a photo, as it can create a light reflection, too.
  • Finally, remember that the passport photo must be as natural as possible and must resemble you on a regular day.
photo_didentite.titre_accordeon: Can you wear makeup in a passport photo?

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
• Strong colors that stand out clearly from the background are suitable for a passport photo. Since a light background is required, darker colors are beneficial to increase contrast.
  • Also, make sure your shirt doesn't show too much skin, as shirtless passport photos are prohibited.
  • Finally, uniforms of any kind are also prohibited on a biometric passport photo.
